project: Weave Self-Iteration Upper-Layer E2E Gate Hardening
description: Small Ralph self-iteration for the current branch. The prior PRD belonged to `ralph/self-iteration-20260519-044235` and all stories were passing, so this branch starts a fresh small PRD. No PR exists for this branch and no branch workflow runs exist yet. The latest main CI run is green after PR #22. Local baseline checks for the targeted Web contract surface passed before story work: `npm --prefix web test -- --run src/lib/__tests__/playwrightSpecContracts.test.ts`, `npm --prefix web exec playwright test -- --list us444/08-app-builder.spec.ts`, and `git diff --check`. The May 17 dogfood issues DOG-002 through DOG-005 already have current code/tests, and the named fresh-CI risks are not active: committed `cmd/server/web/dist` exists for `cmd/server/embed.go`, and US-453 has streamless binary-response coverage. This PRD focuses on upper-layer US-444 smoke gates that still accept skipped/degraded endpoint coverage even though the full PG stack wires the corresponding OSv2-style services.

userStories.name: Make the US-444 App Builder gate reject unwired Apps APIs
userStories.description: Strengthen the App Builder Playwright smoke probe so a reachable full-stack backend must expose `/api/v2/apps` create/get/delete instead of treating 404/503 or create failures as a passing skipped mode.
bdd_acceptance: Given the US-444 Playwright suite runs against a reachable full-stack backend, When `us444/08-app-builder.spec.ts` creates a Workshop-lite app, Then a 404 or 503 from `POST /api/v2/apps` fails the test instead of calling `test.skip`.
Given app creation succeeds, When the spec fetches and deletes the created app by RID, Then the get and delete endpoints must return successful statuses and the returned RID must remain non-empty.
Given Playwright runs in list-only CI discovery, When `us444/08-app-builder.spec.ts` is parsed, Then the scenario remains discoverable and contains no `test.skip` or `test.fixme` guards.

userStories.name: Make the US-444 Quiver gate reject unwired dashboard APIs
userStories.description: Strengthen the Quiver Playwright smoke probe so a reachable full-stack backend must expose save/list/delete dashboard APIs rather than passing through store-unwired skips.
bdd_acceptance: Given the US-444 Playwright suite runs against a reachable full-stack backend, When `us444/09-quiver.spec.ts` saves a dashboard, Then 404/503 and other non-OK save responses fail the test instead of skipping.
Given dashboard save succeeds, When the spec lists and deletes the dashboard by RID, Then list and delete statuses are asserted as wired and successful.
Given Playwright runs in list-only CI discovery, When `us444/09-quiver.spec.ts` is parsed, Then the scenario remains discoverable and contains no `test.skip` or `test.fixme` guards.

userStories.name: Make the US-444 package lifecycle gate reject unwired installer APIs
userStories.description: Strengthen the marketplace/package installer smoke probes so the built-in package catalog and install endpoints stay mandatory in full-stack E2E coverage.
bdd_acceptance: Given the full-stack backend exposes built-in seed packages, When `us444/10-marketplace.spec.ts` requests the catalog, Then an empty compiled-in catalog fails instead of skipping the package assertion.
Given the built-in `iot-demo` package exists, When `us444/11-pkg-install.spec.ts` runs, Then unavailable catalog or installer responses fail instead of being skipped.

Given Playwright runs in list-only CI discovery, When the marketplace and package install specs are parsed, Then their core scenarios remain discoverable without permanent `test.skip` or `test.fixme` guards.
quality_gates: `npm --prefix web exec playwright test -- --list us444/10-marketplace.spec.ts us444/11-pkg-install.spec.ts`
`rg -n "test\\.(skip|fixme)\\(" web/e2e/us444/10-marketplace.spec.ts web/e2e/us444/11-pkg-install.spec.ts` must return no matches
